*   Constraint: No private coordination.
*   Selection Rule: "Candidates qualify when quality is at least 80 and defects are at most 5 raw counts. Choose the qualifying candidate with lowest energy, breaking ties by lowest candidate ID; choose reject_all only when no candidate qualifies."
